ambiguities_or_notes: French original and Russian editorial rendering are both translated in source order, including the Russian sentence embedded in the French original, the fourth-page address, editorial note, and all sixteen duplicated apparatus footnotes.

The editorial note says Yergolskaya marked the letter Received 21 June 1851 although the letter is dated June 24. Official volume 59 prints the same impossible chronology; it is preserved verbatim and flagged here as an unresolved printed anomaly rather than emended.
point d’appui is kept as point of support in the direct French layer; the separate Russian rendering uses support.
figure bourgeonnée is rendered pimpled face in the direct French; the Russian editorial rendering’s пятнастое лицо is separately rendered spotted face.
The distinction between military service and civil service under Prince Vorontsov is retained exactly.
